core_meaning.primary_meaning: Harir is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Silk; a fine, smooth fabric”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Harir corresponds to the Arabic form حرير (Arabic root ح ر ر (ḥ-r-r); حَرِير (Ḥarīr)). Its core sense is sweet, pure, clear. Harir is Arabic حَرِير (Ḥarīr) 'silk; a fine, smooth fabric', from the root ح ر ر (ḥ-r-r). The source gloss 'sweet, pure, clear' is unsupported; the lexical sense is 'silk'. Recorded at medium confidence because the word is primarily a common noun and its use as a given name is less frequent. Used for both men and women.

persian.name: حرير
persian.long_meaning: Harir (حرير) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن شیرین، پاک، صاف است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
